attributes.probed_form: RETAINED, the same three-part composite as setWorldParms, transposed to this function's names (commit 7bb1751d5). (A) Fifteen inner clamp sites: `{ f32 v = xN * sc; if (v < lo) { v = lo; } else if (v > hi) { v = hi; } q->p_parms[K].o.FIELD = v; }` -> `xN = xN * sc; if (xN < lo) { xN = lo; } else if (xN > hi) { xN = hi; } q->p_parms[K].o.FIELD = xN;`. Alone: real 496 -> 592, insns 793 -> 783, multiset 40t -> 30t, whole ours-only fmr class gone, ours exactly 10 short = the 10 target-only b. (B) Five outer groups: `x3 = x3 * sc; if (!(x3 < lo)) { if (!(x3 > hi)) { hi = x3; } lo = hi; }` -> `x3 = x3 * sc; lo = (x3 < lo) ? lo : (hi = (x3 > hi) ? hi : x3);`, plus `f32 sc, lo, hi;` added to EACH of the two `f32 x3, x2, x1, x0;` block scopes. On top of (A): multiset 30t -> 2t, insns 795, with TWO surplus fmr - one in the first group of EACH declaration block (@0x60c and @0xa9c). (C) THE CONTROLLED TEST: delete both per-block `f32 sc, lo, hi;` and declare ONCE at function scope after `u32 used;`. Predicted before building: one declaration scope should leave exactly ONE failure instead of two. Measured: multiset 2t -> 1t, insns 795 -> 794, and the @0xa9c cluster vanished while @0x60c remained - the prediction held exactly.
